text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Hearing that Mejiro Ardan had fallen ill 
during class, I rushed frantically to the 
infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I am deeply ashamed. It was a 
history class, so I suppose I got a bit 
carried away—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I only got a little dizzy, and I'm 
already feeling better... ugh—”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...It feels like my body is telling me not 
to push myself too hard today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Being able to tell your physical condition 
like this gives mixed feelings—I'm not 
sure if it's good or bad.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Mejiro Ardan let out a deep breath 
and lay down on her bed.
